  # Shown here, unlike the other chapters: a warning of the scoring (a join

Reads the assignments of every dataset that has a store, cleans the taxonomy
strings, builds the `Gen_sp_*` and the consensus columns (Q3.1, Q3.3), gives
every unit its own truth (`R/mock_truth.R`, ROADMAP 0.6) and scores the
columns with `comparpq::tc_metrics_unit()` (ROADMAP 0.7). Every later chapter
reads `res_comp_tax` from `analysis/_cache/`, written at the end of this file.
The **Summary** of the results comes right after the scoring (§ Summary): it
reads the scores this file builds, so it cannot come first.

Since 2026-09-27 (OD 34) the grid assigns **the ITSx inputs only**: one input
per ITSx region of the dataset (`region`: ITS1 for the Pauvert mock; ITS1,
ITS2 and full for a full-ITS amplicon) and per unit. Each region is scored on
three units, told apart by the `unit` column:

| `unit` | Object | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `ASV` | `d_all_taxo_<region>_asv` | the ITSx-extracted ASVs, plus the consensus columns of that region |
| `OTU` | `d_all_taxo_<region>_otu` | their 97 % clusters, assigned directly (OD 4) |
| `OTU_derived` | built here | the same clusters, their taxonomy resolved from the member ASVs (decision 25) |

`OTU` against `OTU_derived` is the "cluster then assign" versus "assign then
cluster" comparison of Q5; both are kept on the developer's decision of
2026-09-22, now within each region.

```{r setup}
here::i_am("analysis/01_load_and_clean.qmd")  # _quarto.yml would otherwise make here() root = analysis/
source(here::here("analysis/00_setup.R"))
source(here("R/mock_truth.R"))
source(here("R/otu_taxonomy.R"))
source(here("R/score_assignments.R"))
# clean_taxo(), add_gen_sp() and build_ranks_df(), shared with the in silico
# chapter since 2026-09-23 (C22-S4).
source(here("R/assignment_helpers.R"))
```

# Datasets

One row per dataset whose assignment store exists (`analysis_datasets` in
`00_setup.R`), with its ITSx regions and units. The ASV truth is built from the
denoised ASVs of the DADA2 store, matched by taxon name: `itsx_pq()` keeps
the name of the most abundant ASV when it merges ASVs that became identical
once trimmed. The OTU truth is built on the real OTUs of each region, whose
sequences are the trimmed ones.

```{r datasets}
analysis_datasets |>
  mutate(
    regions = vapply(regions, paste, character(1), collapse = ", "),
    units = vapply(units, paste, character(1), collapse = ", ")
  )
```

# Helpers

`clean_taxo()`, `add_gen_sp()` and `build_ranks_df()` live in
`R/assignment_helpers.R` (sourced above), so the in silico positive control
is prepared exactly as the mocks are without entering this chapter's
`res_comp_tax` (OD 29). `build_ranks_df()` takes the ranks and the mini-store
tolerance explicitly: `ranks = tax_order, allow_empty = analysis_mini`.

# Consensus columns

Three base strategies, then (Q3.1) `consensus` + `abs_majority`, the
`strict = TRUE` variants of all five, and (Q3.3) `rel_majority` with
`nb_agree_threshold` 2 and 3. **One consensus per region** (developer,
2026-09-27): it votes over the columns of that region's ASV input, and its
columns are named `<input>_<strategy>` (`ITS1_asv_rel_majority_consensus`).

Q3 votes over one column per method × database, at the default settings
(developer, 2026-09-22): 4 × 9 = 36 columns of equal weight. A method
contributes as many columns as it has parameter rows, so the 12 blastn rows per
database would carry 57 % of the vote and count the same BLAST search four
times. Every other column is set aside before the vote and added back after.

```{r helpers-consensus}
extra_consensus_configs <- list(
  list(method = "consensus",    strict = FALSE, nb = 1L, suffix = "consensus_consensus"),
  list(method = "abs_majority", strict = FALSE, nb = 1L, suffix = "abs_majority_consensus"),
  list(method = "rel_majority", strict = TRUE,  nb = 1L, suffix = "rel_majority_strict_consensus"),
  list(method = "preference",   strict = TRUE,  nb = 1L, suffix = "preference_strict_consensus"),
  list(method = "unanimity",    strict = TRUE,  nb = 1L, suffix = "unanimity_strict_consensus"),
  list(method = "consensus",    strict = TRUE,  nb = 1L, suffix = "consensus_strict_consensus"),
  list(method = "abs_majority", strict = TRUE,  nb = 1L, suffix = "abs_majority_strict_consensus"),
  list(method = "rel_majority", strict = FALSE, nb = 2L, suffix = "rel_majority_nb2_consensus"),
  list(method = "rel_majority", strict = FALSE, nb = 3L, suffix = "rel_majority_nb3_consensus")
)
base_consensus_configs <- list(
  list(method = "rel_majority", strict = FALSE, nb = 1L, suffix = "rel_majority_consensus"),
  list(method = "preference",   strict = FALSE, nb = 1L, suffix = "preference_consensus"),
  list(method = "unanimity",    strict = FALSE, nb = 1L, suffix = "unanimity_consensus")
)
consensus_configs <- c(base_consensus_configs, extra_consensus_configs)

# Consensus column labels of one input ("ITS1_asv_rel_majority_consensus").
consensus_labels_for <- function(input) {
  paste0(input, "_", vapply(consensus_configs, \(cfg) cfg$suffix, character(1)))
}

# The default settings of filter_default_settings() (00_setup.R), as the
# `full_name` of one input of one dataset: one column per method and database.
default_names_for <- function(vm, input) {
  vm |>
    filter(.data$input == .env$input) |>
    filter(
      (method %in% c("dada2", "sintax") & min_bootstrap == 0.5) |
        (method == "lca" & lca_cutoff == 0.51) |
        (method == "blastn" & vote_algorithm == "rel_majority" & min_id == 95)
    ) |>
    pull(full_name)
}

add_consensus_columns <- function(physeq, vm, input, ranks = tax_order) {
  consensus_cols <- as.vector(outer(ranks, default_names_for(vm, input), paste, sep = "_"))
  assignment_cols <- grep(
    paste0("^(", paste(ranks, collapse = "|"), ")_"),
    colnames(physeq@tax_table),
    value = TRUE
  )
  missing_consensus <- setdiff(consensus_cols, assignment_cols)
  if (length(missing_consensus) > 0 && !analysis_mini) {
    print(missing_consensus)
    stop("Default-settings columns expected by the Q3 consensus are missing.")
  }
  consensus_cols <- intersect(consensus_cols, assignment_cols)
  # Every column but the voters is set aside, not only the other assignment
  # columns: the rank patterns are unanchored, so the bare Kingdom ... Genus
  # columns that d_asv brings from store_dada2 (the DADA2 pipeline's own
  # taxonomy) voted too, a 37th voter (found 2026-09-30, C22-P21).
  aside_cols <- setdiff(colnames(physeq@tax_table), consensus_cols)
  aside_taxtab <- tax_table_to_df(physeq, convert = FALSE)[, c("taxon", aside_cols)]
  message(
    input, ": Q3 consensus over ", length(consensus_cols) / length(ranks),
    " assignment columns per rank; ", length(aside_cols), " columns set aside"
  )
  if (length(aside_cols) > 0) {
    physeq <- select_taxa_pq(physeq, !dplyr::all_of(aside_cols))
  }

  for (cfg in consensus_configs) {
    args <- list(
      physeq              = physeq,
      pattern_tax_ranks   = ranks,
      method              = cfg$method,
      strict              = cfg$strict,
      nb_agree_threshold  = cfg$nb,
      new_names           = paste0(ranks, "_", input, "_", cfg$suffix),
      replace_collapsed_rank_by_NA = TRUE
    )
    if (cfg$method == "preference") {
      args$preference_pattern <- paste0(input, "_", preference_pattern)
    }
    physeq <- do.call(resolve_taxo_conflict, args)
  }

  if (length(aside_cols) > 0) {
    aside_rows <- match(taxa_names(physeq), aside_taxtab$taxon)
    physeq <- do.call(
      mutate_taxa_pq,
      c(list(physeq = physeq), as.list(aside_taxtab[aside_rows, aside_cols, drop = FALSE]))
    )
  }
  physeq
}
```

# One dataset, one region at a time

```{r prepare}
# Everything one region of one dataset needs to be scored: the three objects,
# their truths and the lineage of the external controls.
prepare_region <- function(ds, region, truth_asv, cfg) {
  message("\n== ", ds$dataset, " / ", region, " ==")
  vm <- values_map_for(ds$dataset)
  asv_input <- paste0(region, "_asv")
  d_asv_r <- tar_read_raw(paste0("d_all_taxo_", asv_input), store = ds$store) |>
    clean_taxo() |>
    add_gen_sp()
  out <- list(
    dataset = ds$dataset,
    region = region,
    vm = vm,
    truth_asv = truth_asv,
    external_truth = external_control_truth(taxa_names(d_asv_r))
  )
  # The real ASVs that ITSx trimmed in this region; the others are assigned
  # on their whole sequence (OD 38).
  is_trimmed <- itsx_trimmed(ds$store, ds$dada2_store, region)
  out$trimmed <- names(is_trimmed)[is_trimmed]
  out$trimming <- tibble::tibble(
    dataset = ds$dataset,
    region = region,
    real_units = length(is_trimmed),
    trimmed = sum(is_trimmed),
    untrimmed = sum(!is_trimmed)
  )

  if ("otu" %in% ds$units[[1]]) {
    otu_input <- paste0(region, "_otu")
    out$d_otu_r <- tar_read_raw(paste0("d_all_taxo_", otu_input), store = ds$store) |>
      clean_taxo() |>
      add_gen_sp()
    # The OTU truth is built on the trimmed sequences of the real OTUs.
    out$truth_otu <- build_mock_truth(
      tar_read_raw(paste0("d_", otu_input, "_real"), store = ds$store),
      cfg
    )
    # Taxonomy of the clusters resolved from the member ASVs (Q5, decision
    # 25): no assignment is recomputed, an OTU keeps the value all its
    # assigned member ASVs agree on. Built before the consensus columns.
    clusters <- tar_read_raw(paste0("otu_clusters_", region), store = ds$store)
    # Kept for the ASV subsampling of Q5 (one member per cluster).
    out$clusters <- clusters
    out$d_otu_derived <- resolve_otu_taxonomy(d_asv_r, clusters, method = "unanimity")
    message(
      ntaxa(d_asv_r), " taxa (ASVs and controls) merged into ",
      ntaxa(out$d_otu_derived), " (OTUs and controls); ",
      sum(!is.na(out$truth_otu$truth_depth)), " of ", nrow(out$truth_otu),
      " OTUs have a truth, ", sum(out$truth_otu$foreign),
      " are foreign to the mock (OD 36)"
    )
  }
  out$d_asv_r <- add_consensus_columns(d_asv_r, vm, asv_input)
  out
}

prepare_dataset <- function(ds) {
  cfg <- mock_sanger_tables[mock_sanger_tables$dataset == ds$dataset, ]
  truth_asv <- build_mock_truth(tar_read(d_asv, store = ds$dada2_store), cfg)
  message(
    ds$dataset, ": ", sum(!is.na(truth_asv$truth_depth)), " of ",
    nrow(truth_asv), " ASVs have a truth, ", sum(truth_asv$foreign),
    " are foreign to the mock (OD 36)"
  )
  regions <- ds$regions[[1]]
  setNames(lapply(regions, \(r) prepare_region(ds, r, truth_asv, cfg)), regions)
}

prepared <- setNames(
  lapply(seq_len(nrow(analysis_datasets)), \(i) prepare_dataset(analysis_datasets[i, ])),
  analysis_datasets$dataset
)
# One entry per dataset x region, in that order.
prepared_regions <- unlist(unname(prepared), recursive = FALSE)
```

# Scoring

`score_assignments()` (`R/score_assignments.R`) groups the columns by the
treatment their database imposes on the `external_` controls — in the matrix on
the three `_Fungi` databases, aside on the whole releases and on the three
`_Fungi_rep` (with `ext_correct` at the kingdom only, OD 6, 15, 22) — and calls
`comparpq::tc_metrics_unit()` once per group. The consensus columns have no
database and are scored both ways; the `external_scoring` column tells the two
readings apart.

**Two truth rules (OD 44).** A real unit whose best hit on a member lies
between 90 and 99.5 % (a sequencing error, or a variant absent from the
reference sequences of the mock) has no truth. The paper measures the
assignment step, not how well sequencing reproduces the community, so every
column is scored twice, told apart by `truth_rule`:

- `no_truth_aside` (**leads** every summary and main figure): such units
  leave the matrix at every rank, as the foreign units (OD 36);
  `no_truth_named` gives the share a method names;
- `q2b`: they stay in the matrix, FP when named and FN when left NA, an error
  whatever the method does (Q2b, the stricter reading).

`res_comp_tax`, `res_paired` and `res_subsample` hold both rules,
`res_abundance` Q2b only. Every reader keeps one rule (`default_view()`,
`keep_truth_rule()`, `00_setup.R`).

**Real units in the headline (OD 49).** F1, PPV and FDR are scored on the
real units only: a named control does not lower them, so they do not depend
on how many controls were added. The controls report through their own rates
(`NA_fake`, `ext_fungi`, `ext_correct`, `ctrl_assigned_*`); the values with
the controls in the matrix stay as `F1_with_ctrl`, `PPV_with_ctrl` and
`FDR_with_ctrl` (`real_units_headline()`, `R/score_assignments.R`). TPR
never involves the controls; MCC, ACC and TNR keep them, the TN cell being
theirs. The `FP` cell still counts the named controls of the matrix.

```{r score}
score_region <- function(prep) {
  asv_input <- paste0(prep$region, "_asv")
  asv_names <- prep$vm$full_name[prep$vm$input == asv_input]
  asv <- build_ranks_df(
    prep$d_asv_r, c(consensus_labels_for(asv_input), asv_names),
    ranks = tax_order, allow_empty = analysis_mini
  )
  res <- score_truth_rules(
    prep$d_asv_r, asv, prep$truth_asv, db_meta,
    external_truth = prep$external_truth, truth_ranks = truth_ranks
  ) |>
    mutate(unit = "ASV")

  if (!is.null(prep$d_otu_r)) {
    otu_names <- prep$vm$full_name[prep$vm$input == paste0(prep$region, "_otu")]
    otu <- build_ranks_df(prep$d_otu_r, otu_names, ranks = tax_order, allow_empty = analysis_mini)
    derived <- build_ranks_df(prep$d_otu_derived, asv_names, ranks = tax_order, allow_empty = analysis_mini)
    res <- bind_rows(
      res,
      score_truth_rules(
        prep$d_otu_r, otu, prep$truth_otu, db_meta,
        external_truth = prep$external_truth, truth_ranks = truth_ranks
      ) |>
        mutate(unit = "OTU"),
      score_truth_rules(
        prep$d_otu_derived, derived, prep$truth_asv, db_meta,
        external_truth = prep$external_truth, truth_ranks = truth_ranks
      ) |>
        mutate(unit = "OTU_derived")
    )
  }
  mutate(res, dataset = prep$dataset)
}

res_comp_tax <- bind_rows(lapply(prepared_regions, score_region)) |>
  # tc_metrics_unit() labels the last rank after the truth table ("Species");
  # the columns it read are the `Gen_sp_*` ones, and every chapter filters on
  # "Gen_sp" (tax_order).
  mutate(tax_level = ifelse(tax_level == "Species", "Gen_sp", tax_level)) |>
  enrich_metrics()

res_comp_tax |>
  count(dataset, region, unit, truth_rule, external_scoring) |>
  arrange(dataset, region, unit, truth_rule)
```

# Summary

```{r summary-data}
#| include: false
# Computed from the scores just built, through the same default_view() as
# chapters 02 to 05 (here for every unit, not only the ASVs).
s01_views <- analysis_views(res_comp_tax)
s01_rows <- bind_rows(lapply(
  c("ASV", "OTU", "OTU_derived"),
  \(u) view_rows(res_comp_tax, s01_views, keep_unit = u)
))
s01_genus <- s01_rows |>
  filter(metrics == "F1_score", tax_level == "Genus") |>
  filter_default_settings()
s01_means <- s01_genus |>
  group_by(dataset, region, unit) |>
  summarise(columns = n(), F1 = round(mean(values), 3), .groups = "drop")
# Truth of the ASVs, per dataset (the same for every region).
s01_truth <- bind_rows(lapply(names(prepared), function(ds) {
  truth <- prepared[[ds]][[1]]$truth_asv
  tibble(
    dataset = ds,
    asv = nrow(truth),
    with_truth = sum(!is.na(truth$truth_depth)),
    foreign = sum(truth$foreign)
  )
}))
s01_truth_phrase <- paste0(
  s01_truth$dataset, " ", s01_truth$with_truth, " of ", s01_truth$asv,
  " ASVs (", s01_truth$foreign, " foreign to the mock)",
  collapse = "; "
)
s01_mean_phrase <- s01_means |>
  group_by(dataset, unit) |>
  summarise(F1 = fmt_range(F1), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(dataset) |>
  summarise(txt = paste0(unit, " ", F1, collapse = ", "), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(txt = paste0(dataset, ": ", txt)) |>
  pull(txt) |>
  paste(collapse = "; ")
# Controls at Genus, default columns, ASVs: shuffled ones named, and foreign
# units named (OD 36).
s01_ctrl <- s01_rows |>
  filter(unit == "ASV", tax_level == "Genus", metrics %in% c("NA_fake", "foreign_named")) |>
  filter_default_settings() |>
  mutate(
    value = ifelse(metrics == "NA_fake", 1 - values, values),
    control = ifelse(metrics == "NA_fake", "shuffled controls named", "foreign units named")
  ) |>
  filter(!is.nan(value))
s01_fake_max <- s01_ctrl |>
  filter(control == "shuffled controls named") |>
  group_by(algo) |>
  summarise(max = max(value), .groups = "drop")
```

Scored: `r paste(s01_views$label, collapse = ", ")`, each on ASV, OTU and
OTU_derived, against the per-unit truth. The figures and sentences below
read the lead truth rule (`no_truth_aside`, OD 44); the last table compares
it with Q2b.

- **Truth**: `r s01_truth_phrase`. Foreign units are left out of the matrix
  and reported by `foreign_named` (OD 36).
- **Genus F1** at the default settings, mean of the 36 method × database
  columns, range over the regions: `r s01_mean_phrase`.
- **Shuffled controls given a genus** (ASVs, default columns), worst database
  per method: `r paste0(s01_fake_max$algo, " ", round(100 * s01_fake_max$max, 1), " %", collapse = ", ")`.

# M1.5 — abundance filter

Hleap et al. 2021 dropped the ASVs below 8 reads before assigning them. Here
the filter is applied afterwards, as a sweep: the metrics are recomputed on the
units carrying at least *n* reads, *n* running from 1 (no filter) to 100. It
answers whether the ranking of the methods and databases survives the filter,
and how much of each score rests on units nobody would keep.

The sweep runs on the default settings only (the four methods × the nine
databases) and on the ASV and OTU inputs of every region: it multiplies the
scoring by the number of thresholds, and the parameter sweeps of Q1 are read at
one threshold.

**The filter applies to the real units only.** The negative controls are
injected sequences and carry no reads at all (`add_shuffle_seq_pq()` and
`add_external_seq_pq()` add them to the tax_table and the refseq, with a zero
count), so filtering them with the rest would remove every one of them at the
first threshold and empty the TN column — TNR would jump from its real value to
0/0 between *n* = 1 and *n* = 2 and read as an effect of the filter.

```{r abundance-sweep}
# 1 is the unfiltered baseline, added to M1.5's list. On the Pauvert mock it
# gives the same counts as 2, because no ASV carries a single read (the
# DADA2 minimum there is 2); on another dataset the two will differ.
abundance_thresholds <- c(1:10, 12, 15, 20, 30, 40, 50, 100)

sweep_abundance <- function(prep, thresholds = abundance_thresholds) {
  inputs <- list(
    ASV = list(
      physeq = prep$d_asv_r,
      truth = prep$truth_asv,
      names = default_names_for(prep$vm, paste0(prep$region, "_asv"))
    )
  )
  if (!is.null(prep$d_otu_r)) {
    inputs$OTU <- list(
      physeq = prep$d_otu_r,
      truth = prep$truth_otu,
      names = default_names_for(prep$vm, paste0(prep$region, "_otu"))
    )
  }
  bind_rows(lapply(names(inputs), function(unit) {
    input <- inputs[[unit]]
    ranks_df <- build_ranks_df(input$physeq, input$names, ranks = tax_order, allow_empty = analysis_mini)
    is_control <- grepl(control_pattern, taxa_names(input$physeq))
    bind_rows(lapply(thresholds, function(n) {
      kept <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(input$physeq) >= n | is_control, input$physeq)
      # Q2b only (OD 44): the sweep is not doubled.
      score_truth_rules(
        kept, ranks_df, input$truth, db_meta,
        external_truth = prep$external_truth, truth_ranks = truth_ranks,
        rules = truth_rules["q2b"]
      ) |>
        mutate(
          unit = unit,
          min_reads = n,
          n_units_kept = sum(taxa_sums(input$physeq) >= n & !is_control)
        )
    }))
  })) |>
    mutate(dataset = prep$dataset)
}

res_abundance <- bind_rows(lapply(prepared_regions, sweep_abundance)) |>
  mutate(tax_level = ifelse(tax_level == "Species", "Gen_sp", tax_level)) |>
  enrich_metrics()

res_abundance |>
  distinct(dataset, region, unit, min_reads, n_units_kept) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = unit, values_from = n_units_kept)
```

```{r abundance-figure}
res_abundance |>
  filter(dataset == analysis_datasets$dataset[[1]]) |>
  filter(region == prepared_regions[[1]]$region) |>
  filter(metrics %in% c("F1_score", "TPR", "NA_real")) |>
  filter(tax_level %in% c("Genus", "Gen_sp")) |>
  left_join(select(db_meta, db, simplification), by = "db") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = min_reads, y = values, colour = algo, linetype = unit)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = interaction(method_db, unit)), alpha = 0.8) +
```

## ASVs subsampled to the OTU count (Q5)

The OTU inputs have fewer units than the ASVs, and the scoring counts units,
so an ASV against OTU difference mixes the assignment of each sequence with
the change of unit set (chapter 08). Two nulls, `subsample_draws` draws each,
without replacement, on the default settings and the ASV truth, every control
kept:

- `ASV_random`: as many real ASVs as there are OTU clusters, drawn at random.
  It tests whether the **number** of units explains the OTU score.
- `ASV_one_per_cluster`: one random member ASV per cluster, the structure of
  the OTUs with another representative than the most abundant one. It tests
  whether the OTU score comes from **which** ASV stands for each cluster.

```{r subsample-sweep}
subsample_draws <- 100

sweep_subsample <- function(prep, draws = subsample_draws) {
  if (is.null(prep$clusters)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  physeq <- prep$d_asv_r
  cols <- default_names_for(prep$vm, paste0(prep$region, "_asv"))
  ranks_df <- build_ranks_df(physeq, cols, ranks = tax_order, allow_empty = analysis_mini)
  is_control <- grepl(control_pattern, taxa_names(physeq))
  members <- filter(prep$clusters, taxon %in% taxa_names(physeq)[!is_control])
  n_units <- n_distinct(members$cluster)
  score_kept <- function(kept_taxa, scheme, draw) {
    kept <- prune_taxa(taxa_names(physeq) %in% kept_taxa | is_control, physeq)
    score_truth_rules(
      kept, ranks_df, prep$truth_asv, db_meta,
      external_truth = prep$external_truth, truth_ranks = truth_ranks
    ) |>
      mutate(unit = scheme, draw = draw, n_units_kept = length(kept_taxa))
  }
  # One seed per dataset x region, so that adding a region does not change
  # the draws of the others.
  withr::with_seed(targets_seed + match(prep$region, c("ITS1", "ITS2", "full")), {
    bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(draws), function(i) {
      random <- sample(members$taxon, n_units)
      one_per_cluster <- members |>
        group_by(cluster) |>
        slice_sample(n = 1) |>
        pull(taxon)
      bind_rows(
        score_kept(random, "ASV_random", i),
        score_kept(one_per_cluster, "ASV_one_per_cluster", i)
      )
    }))
  }) |>
    mutate(dataset = prep$dataset)
}

res_subsample <- bind_rows(lapply(prepared_regions, sweep_subsample)) |>
  mutate(tax_level = ifelse(tax_level == "Species", "Gen_sp", tax_level)) |>
  enrich_metrics()

res_subsample |>
  distinct(dataset, region, unit, n_units_kept) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = unit, values_from = n_units_kept)
```

## ASVs trimmed in every region (Q4)

ITSx does not find every region in every ASV. A unit whose region it does not
find stays in the input on its whole sequence (`keep_undetected = TRUE`, so no
unit is lost for Q1–Q3 and Q5), and the units that become identical once
trimmed are merged. So the regions of a dataset hold different units, and
some of them are not the region at all (chapter 07). Here each region is
scored again on the real ASVs that ITSx **trimmed in every region** of its
dataset (`unit = "ASV_common"`, OD 38), default settings, ASV truth. For
contrast, `unit = "ASV_common_all"` keeps every real ASV present in all the
regions, trimmed or not (the reading before OD 38). The controls cannot be
paired (each region's `fake_` controls are shuffled from its own sequences):
every region keeps its own, as in the main scoring.

```{r common-units}
score_common_units <- function(preps) {
  if (length(preps) < 2) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  real_names <- lapply(preps, function(prep) {
    tn <- taxa_names(prep$d_asv_r)
    tn[!grepl(control_pattern, tn)]
  })
  bind_rows(
    score_on_units(preps, Reduce(intersect, lapply(preps, `[[`, "trimmed")), "ASV_common"),
    score_on_units(preps, Reduce(intersect, real_names), "ASV_common_all")
  )
}

# Every region of `preps` scored on the real units `common` and the controls.
score_on_units <- function(preps, common, unit) {
  bind_rows(lapply(preps, function(prep) {
    physeq <- prep$d_asv_r
    cols <- default_names_for(prep$vm, paste0(prep$region, "_asv"))
    ranks_df <- build_ranks_df(physeq, cols, ranks = tax_order, allow_empty = analysis_mini)
    kept <- prune_taxa(
      taxa_names(physeq) %in% common | grepl(control_pattern, taxa_names(physeq)),
      physeq
    )
    score_truth_rules(
      kept, ranks_df, prep$truth_asv, db_meta,
      external_truth = prep$external_truth, truth_ranks = truth_ranks
    ) |>
      mutate(unit = unit, n_units_kept = length(common), dataset = prep$dataset)
  }))
}

res_paired <- bind_rows(lapply(prepared, score_common_units)) |>
  mutate(tax_level = ifelse(tax_level == "Species", "Gen_sp", tax_level)) |>
  enrich_metrics()

res_paired |>
  distinct(dataset, unit, region, n_units_kept)

# Real units, trimmed and untrimmed, per dataset and region (chapter 07).
itsx_trimming <- bind_rows(lapply(prepared_regions, `[[`, "trimming"))
itsx_trimming
```

## Per-unit cells (OD 50)

The chapters give each paired difference of Genus F1 and PPV a 95 %
bootstrap interval (OD 50, `R/paired_bootstrap.R`): the units are resampled
and every column is scored again on the same draw. They need the cell of
each real unit, not only the counts: `res_cells` holds them at Genus, under
the lead truth rule, for the default columns and the consensus columns of
every input (`comparpq::tc_cells_unit()` through `real_unit_cells()`). The
controls are left out, as in the headline (OD 49). `group` is the OTU cluster
of the unit, so that a draw takes a cluster's ASVs and its OTU together
(Q5); `common` marks the ASVs trimmed in every region of their dataset
(Q4.4, OD 38).

```{r cells}
cells_region <- function(prep, common) {
  cells_of <- function(physeq, cols, truth, unit) {
    ranks_df <- build_ranks_df(physeq, cols, ranks = tax_order, allow_empty = analysis_mini)
    real_unit_cells(
      physeq, ranks_df, truth,
      truth_ranks = truth_ranks, no_truth = truth_rules[[lead_truth_rule]]
    ) |>
      mutate(unit = unit)
  }
  asv_input <- paste0(prep$region, "_asv")
  asv_cols <- default_names_for(prep$vm, asv_input)
  cells <- cells_of(
    prep$d_asv_r, c(consensus_labels_for(asv_input), asv_cols), prep$truth_asv, "ASV"
  )
  if (!is.null(prep$d_otu_r)) {
    cells <- bind_rows(
      cells,
      cells_of(
        prep$d_otu_r, default_names_for(prep$vm, paste0(prep$region, "_otu")),
        prep$truth_otu, "OTU"
      ),
      cells_of(prep$d_otu_derived, asv_cols, prep$truth_asv, "OTU_derived")
    )
  }
  cluster_of <- if (is.null(prep$clusters)) {
    NULL
  } else {
    setNames(as.character(prep$clusters$cluster), prep$clusters$taxon)
  }
  cells |>
    mutate(
      dataset = prep$dataset,
      region = prep$region,
      group = if (is.null(cluster_of)) taxon else unname(cluster_of[taxon]),
      common = unit == "ASV" & taxon %in% common
    )
}

res_cells <- bind_rows(lapply(prepared, function(preps) {
  common <- if (length(preps) > 1) {
    Reduce(intersect, lapply(preps, `[[`, "trimmed"))
  } else {
    character(0)
  }
  bind_rows(lapply(preps, cells_region, common = common))
}))
stopifnot(!anyNA(res_cells$group))

# The cells must add up to the scores of res_comp_tax, column by column:
# TP, FN, and the real misassignments (misassign_seq x n_real).
cells_counts <- res_cells |>
  count(dataset, region, unit, method_db, cell) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = cell, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)
for (cl in setdiff(c("TP", "FP", "FN"), names(cells_counts))) {
  cells_counts[[cl]] <- 0
}
cells_scores <- res_comp_tax |>
  keep_truth_rule() |>
  filter(tax_level == "Genus", metrics %in% c("TP", "FN", "misassign_seq", "n_real")) |>
  distinct(dataset, region, unit, method_db, metrics, values) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = metrics, values_from = values) |>
  mutate(FP = ifelse(n_real > 0, round(misassign_seq * n_real), 0))
cells_check <- inner_join(
  cells_counts, cells_scores,
  by = c("dataset", "region", "unit", "method_db"), suffix = c("_cells", "_scores")
)
stopifnot(
  nrow(cells_check) == nrow(cells_counts),
  all(cells_check$TP_cells == cells_check$TP_scores),
  all(cells_check$FP_cells == cells_check$FP_scores),
  all(cells_check$FN_cells == cells_check$FN_scores)
)
res_cells |>
  count(dataset, region, unit, common, name = "cells")
```

# Checks

Every input × method must keep rows at the default settings: an
`enrich_metrics()` that failed to read a column name would make every row a
consensus row, and `filter_default_settings()` would then return nothing
without an error.

```{r check-inputs}
check_inputs <- res_comp_tax |>
  filter_default_settings() |>
  count(dataset, region, unit, truth_rule, algo)
check_inputs
stopifnot(nrow(check_inputs) > 0, all(check_inputs$n > 0))
expected <- res_comp_tax |> distinct(dataset, region, unit, truth_rule)
stopifnot(
  nrow(distinct(check_inputs, dataset, region, unit, truth_rule)) == nrow(expected),
  setequal(unique(res_comp_tax$truth_rule), names(truth_rules))
)
```

The species row is the one that fails silently: `truth$Species` is the
underscored binomial of `binomial_name()` and the scored column is
`Gen_sp_*`, built from `Genus_*` and `Species_*`. If the two spellings
disagreed, every unit would be an FP and read as a result.

```{r check-species}
first <- prepared_regions[[1]]
best_gen_sp <- res_comp_tax |>
  keep_truth_rule() |>
  filter(dataset == first$dataset, region == first$region, unit == "ASV",
         tax_level == "Gen_sp", metrics == "TP", algo %in% single_methods) |>
  slice_max(values, n = 3)
best_gen_sp |> select(method_db, values)
stopifnot(max(best_gen_sp$values) > 0)

# A handful of matching spellings, to read with the eye.
tt_first <- tax_table_to_df(first$d_asv_r, convert = FALSE)
gen_sp_col <- paste0("Gen_sp_", best_gen_sp$method_db[[1]])
tibble(
  taxon = tt_first$taxon,
  truth = first$truth_asv$Species[match(tt_first$taxon, first$truth_asv$taxon)],
  assigned = tt_first[[gen_sp_col]]
) |>
  filter(!is.na(truth), !is.na(assigned)) |>
  head(8)
```

Every scored unit falls in exactly one cell of the confusion matrix, so the
four cells sum to the number of scored units — constant across the columns of
one scoring group. The render stops if it is not (code review §4.3).

```{r check-cells}
cells <- res_comp_tax |>
  filter(metrics %in% c("TP", "FP", "FN", "TN")) |>
  group_by(dataset, region, unit, truth_rule, external_scoring, tax_level, method_db) |>
  summarise(n_units = sum(values), .groups = "drop")
cells_per_group <- cells |>
  distinct(dataset, region, unit, truth_rule, external_scoring, tax_level, n_units) |>
  count(dataset, region, unit, truth_rule, external_scoring, tax_level)
stopifnot(all(cells_per_group$n == 1))
cells |>
  distinct(dataset, region, unit, truth_rule, external_scoring, tax_level, n_units) |>
  filter(tax_level %in% c("Genus", "Gen_sp"))
```

Everything below reads the first region of the first dataset only.

```{r na-prop}
res_first <- filter(
  keep_truth_rule(res_comp_tax),
  dataset == first$dataset, region == first$region, unit == "ASV"
)
prop_fake_taxa <- sum(grepl(control_pattern, taxa_names(first$d_asv_r))) /
  ntaxa(first$d_asv_r)

res_first |>
  filter(metrics == "NA_real", external_scoring == "aside" | !is_consensus) |>
  filter(is_consensus | algo %in% single_methods) |>
  filter(!is_consensus | algo %in% c(
    "unanimity_consensus", "preference_consensus", "rel_majority_consensus"
  )) |>
  filter(is_consensus | method_db %in% default_names_for(first$vm, paste0(first$region, "_asv"))) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = values, y = coalesce(db, "consensus"), fill = algo)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge()) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = prop_fake_taxa) +
  facet_grid(algo ~ factor(tax_level, levels = tax_order)) +
  xlim(c(0, 1)) + no_legend() +
  labs(x = "NA_real", y = NULL)
```

```{r explore-tc-bar}
first_input <- paste0(first$region, "_asv")

# psmelt() drops the all-NA rank columns, which happens with the mini_*

          paste(empty_tc_cols, collapse = ", "))

               rank_1 = paste0("Family_", preference_col),
               rank_2 = sintax_seed_db,
               color_rank = paste0("Genus_", preference_col)))

  tc_circle(first$d_asv_r,
            sintax_seed_db,
            paste0("Family_", preference_col))
}
```
